task.title: Run CAS benchmarks without FUSE and distinguish unique from shared bytes
task.problem: The scenario lists mark auto/CAS content searches as requiring FUSE, so a capable runner can report success without a content sample. The large-file fixture repeats identical content.
task.proposal: Describe rg and FUSE prerequisites separately in both catalogues. Keep a shared-blob large-file case and add distinct contents of comparable logical size.
acceptance: With rg and CAS available but no FUSE, synthetic and external CAS content cases run; explicit FUSE cases report a skip. Missing rg is diagnosed separately. An explicitly requested benchmark with no samples is distinguishable from a successful measurement.

Fixture tests verify four distinct payload digests in the unique large-file case and one in the shared case. Report logical files and distinct searched blobs so either case can be recognized in benchmark results.
evidence: The default fixture nominally contains four 16 MiB files, but CAS searches one blob. See https://github.com/rmorozov/bst-utilities/pull/17#pullrequestreview-6013606582 and docs/source-grep-performance.md.
